context: Request: Labor & Employment matters that included equity-vesting acceleration, with the documents describing the terms. Rubric: 1017-00004 (aldrich-settlement-agreement-execution.docx, Section 3(a)), 1017-00005 (Section 10.3; remedial-recommendations-memo.docx or final-investigation-report.docx), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs (all files, one empty extension, one document type).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and an opening memo of three matters at the top of the listing; no keyword search at all.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads an executed agreement, a redline, a diligence memo and a letter of one matter in several passes at offsets, then a draft agreement and a request list of another.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters from the top of the listing as the qualifying ones.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; answered from two matters at the top of a capped listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the few matters in a capped listing without any keyword search, so neither qualifying matter ever surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read on the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two files-with-matches greps for request words plus a glob for matter folders that returns nothing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Shell walk matching request words in file paths.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and draft agreements of four matters whose file names matched.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request terms; times out after about 275K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of an executed agreement, two memos and two drafts from four matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Lists one matter's relevant file names, then a snippet script over three named documents.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five matters as qualifying, three of them from draft agreements and memos.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found and cited both qualifying matters but also listed three draft-only matters as qualifying.

first_error.why: Having read that three matters' agreements were drafts or unsigned offers, it still listed them as matters that included the term alongside the two that did.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for request words.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing request-term hits; about 690K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and draft agreements of three matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of one draft agreement.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over documents in folders whose names match request words, across the store; about 74K chars.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads memos, a draft, an email and an award draft of the three matters it settled on.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script over one draft agreement.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the three draft-stage matters as the qualifying ones.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Both qualifying matters surfaced in the first grep and scan but were never opened; the answer names three draft-stage matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its first grep and scan both listed the two matters it needed, but it chose drafts from three other matters and never opened either.

divergence: All three runs failed, in different stages. T0 never searched and answered from the top of a capped listing (partial listing). T2's first grep and scan listed both qualifying matters, but it read only draft agreements of three other matters (surfaced, never opened). T1 opened both after a scan and cited them, but its answer also listed three draft-only matters (over-inclusion at the write stage).
